Festivals, construction sites, and off-grid locations used to run on roaring diesel generators. Then Greener Power Solutions arrived: a provider of large zero-emission mobile batteries, now Europe's market leader in mobile battery rental, backed by a top tier PE firm. As it scales fast across Europe, the Operations Manager builds the engine that keeps this round-the-clock business running. 
 Amsterdam 
 31 aug 2026 
 Greener Power Solutions 
The idea was born backstage at a festival, where the founders were struck by how much diesel it took to keep the lights on. Greener Power Solutions set out to change that, renting out mobile batteries that deliver clean, quiet power exactly where the grid falls short: festivals, construction sites, film sets, and infrastructure projects. Its self-developed software sets the batteries apart, giving customers real insight into their energy use and steering different sources into one efficient supply. And the market keeps growing. In the Netherlands alone, nearly 10,000 businesses are waiting for electrification. 
What began as a bold alternative to the diesel generator has become the clear market leader. Greener has doubled its revenue and EBITDA every year since its founding in 2018. Since infrastructure investor CVC DIF came on board in 2022, that pace has only accelerated: the fleet has grown from 40 batteries to 300, the team from 20 to 90 people. Greener now operates across the Netherlands, the UK, Spain, France, DACH and the Nordics and Sweden, and with other regions in sight. 
That kind of growth changes what an organization needs. In September 2025, Jasper van den Driest joined as CEO to lead the next phase: the shift from a fast-moving scale-up into a mature, professional company. The commercial engine runs well. jobs.occupation: Food & Beverage Intern - Park Plaza Vondelpark
jobs.description:
At Park Plaza Vondelpark Amsterdam, our boutique hotel environment allows you to build genuine connections with guests while gaining hands-on Food & Beverage experience. From breakfast service to dining at TOZI Amsterdam, every day is an opportunity to learn, grow and make an impact.

Situated in Amsterdam's Oud-Zuid district, our stylish boutique hotel is home to the award-winning TOZI Amsterdam, where authentic Italian flavours and exceptional hospitality come together.

As a Food & Beverage Intern, you will support the team in delivering memorable dining experiences while developing your hospitality skills in a professional and welcoming environment.

Responsibilities

• Support the Food & Beverage team during breakfast, lunch and dinner services

• Deliver a welcoming and professional service to guests

• Assist with the preparation and set-up of restaurant and bar areas

• Take food and beverage orders and ensure guests receive an excellent experience

• Learn and apply Food & Beverage procedures, standards and systems

• Maintain cleanliness and presentation standards across all outlets

• Collaborate with colleagues to ensure smooth daily operations

Essential Requirements

• Currently enrolled in a hospitality, hotel management or related study programme

• Strong communication skills in English (written and spoken)

• Passion for hospitality and guest service

• Positive, professional and enthusiastic attitude

• Eager to learn and develop new skills

• Enjoy working as part of a team in a fast-paced environment

• Eligible to complete an internship in the Netherlands

Preferred Requirements

• Previous experience in hospitality, Food & Beverage or customer service is an advantage

• Interest in restaurant and bar operations

• Dutch or additional language skills are a plus

• Ambition to develop a career within hospitality
